prompt:
Complete TASK.txt following GUIDE.txt. The limits are 120 seconds, 16 command-execution tool items and 6 visible check submissions. All build/check work counts in wall time. Do not delegate.
Use $lobo-development-v2 at .agents/skills/lobo-development-v2/SKILL.md.
last_message:
Implemented the catalog requirements in `logic.lobo` and `policy.lobo`.

- Filters disabled products and unavailable stock correctly.
- Hides disabled product details.
- Rejects leading-zero IDs while preserving overflow/path validation.
- Preserved all declaration IDs and sidecars.
- Native public check: **5/5 passed**.

commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/lobo-development-v2/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- TASK ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' TASK.txt && printf '\\n--- GUIDE ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' GUIDE.txt"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- logic ---'; sed -n '1,260p' logic.lobo; printf '%s\\n' '--- policy ---'; sed -n '1,260p' policy.lobo; printf '%s\\n' '--- logic ids ---'; cat logic.lobo.ids.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- policy ids ---'; cat policy.lobo.ids.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- model ---'; sed -n '1,260p' model.lobo; printf '%s\\n' '--- bundle ---'; cat BUNDLE.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- visible ---'; cat VISIBLE.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- app ---'; sed -n '1,240p' app.lobo; printf '%s\\n' '--- http lib ---'; sed -n '1,280p' lib/http.lobo; printf '%s\\n' '--- json lib ---'; sed -n '1,300p' lib/json.lobo; printf '%s\\n' '--- access ---'; sed -n '1,220p' lib/access.lobo; printf '%s\\n' '--- helpers ---'; sed -n '1,220p' lib/helpers.lobo; printf '%s\\n' '--- io ---'; sed -n '1,180p' lib/io.lobo"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- logic.lobo policy.lobo logic.lobo.ids.json policy.lobo.ids.json && python3 check.py'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,320p' check.py; printf '\\n--- final editable sources ---\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' logic.lobo; sed -n '1,140p' policy.lobo; printf '\\n--- sidecars unchanged shape ---\\n'; cat logic.lobo.ids.json; cat policy.lobo.ids.json"
